dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: He lives next door to me. We're both ninth in our family so our names both have nine in them. That's why we'd be the perfect match... Wait! Argh, no, don't tell Big Nine I said that...

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: The book was a present from him. He's gonna get it published, but he let me have a sneaky look at it first.
